card.name: Yearly and seasonal time words
card.fires_on: Words inside or just before yearly and seasonal timing phrases, such as the 'ly' in yearly, 'during the year', or seasonal cycles of animals and plants. Also seen inside years like 1917.

modes.label: Yearly frequency
modes.description: The ending of yearly or the word year in phrases about how often or when something happens in a year.
modes.example: intermittent (year<<ly>> or twice yearly) single doses of erg

modes.label: Seasonal life cycles
modes.description: Words in descriptions of annual breeding, growth or germination across seasons.
modes.example: typically<< two>> young are born in April or May.

modes.label: Year-end report phrasing
modes.description: The word year in 'during the year' in annual reports.
modes.example: Killings by vigilante groups were widespread during the<< year>>.

card.writes: It pushes down annual and year-half words and pushes up weekly and daily words, so it shifts the predicted time unit away from yearly.
card.plain: It marks yearly and seasonal timing language, and nudges the model toward other time units such as weekly or daily.
